timelineEvents.label: 1926–1930 · Berlin study and networks
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper builds his Berlin career through private study with Moriz Mayer-Mahr and Walther Gmeindl, early publications, and collaboration with Fritz Rotter.
timelineEvents.longDescription: After moving to Berlin, Kaper developed his professional position through private study with pianist Moriz Mayer-Mahr and composer-conductor Walther Gmeindl, while also entering the German-language song market through Fritz Rotter and early publications under the title “Dr. Kaper.”
